issues.message: Reactive blocking call '.block()' inside Spring bean — on a Schedulers.parallel() worker it throws IllegalStateException on every call (measured); compose with .flatMap()/.then() instead, or, if the call must block, run it in Mono.fromCallable(...).subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic()) (a bounded pool: capacity = threads / call duration)

Reactive chain '.toFuture().get()' blocks the calling thread — stay on the reactive pipeline with .flatMap() or .subscribe()
